title.en: Card I: execute W4-B0 rulings (B0-2 re-point + B0-4 NP notes + B0-1 fact registration + observation 1 entity-card dependency fill + B0-3 review addendum; governance only, zero GPU/windows)

intent.zh: 按 Chief 2026-11-11 对 W4-B0 三处待裁项的裁定与 Arch `w4-b0-rulings-addendum.md`（0f484505…/5,445 B，工作材料非证据）：①B0-2 批准执行——`2026-10-11-roadmap-g10-p5`（proposed,0）depends_on 改指已 verified 的 `2026-11-04-g10-p5-family-closeout`，只动依赖/note、不动 acceptance；②B0-4 批准执行——p8-entry/p8-base/r10-p8 的 note 写「前置 = NP5-01/02/03 verified（不是整个 NP 伞卡）；不提前标 NP 通过」；③B0-1 走 (c)：r10-p8/p8-base 的 note 追加「blocked-by-r07-p8；不 waive、不伪造解除；等 R07 收口 verified 或用户明确 waive 后再改指」，**不删** depends_on 里的 r07-p8 边；④卡 G 复核观察 1：7 张 W4 实体卡 depends_on=[] 与「先决条件只认 verified/NP 门禁先行」冲突——按草案 §2 前置列补真实依赖边（E1←NP5 代理、E2←r01-p8、E3←r07-p8+NP 代理+r01–r05/r08/r09、E4←E3、E5←m10-p7、E6←r07-p8+E1–E5+NP 代理、E7←E6+E2+g28-p8+r06-flex-closeout），note 标「登记态待补 checks」不标可开工；⑤B0-3：依赖图复核 0 错误 0 警告，结果 addendum 追加进 docs/development-evidence/plan/W4-dependency-governance.md（不重写）。纯治理写入；不改任何占位卡 acceptance、不改判据/参考/容差；零 GPU、零窗；不写 src/tests/fixtures/scripts。
intent.en: Per Chief's rulings on the three W4-B0 pending items and Arch's w4-b0-rulings-addendum.md (0f484505.../5,445 B, work material): (1) B0-2 approved - re-point 2026-10-11-roadmap-g10-p5 depends_on to the verified 2026-11-04-g10-p5-family-closeout (deps/note only, acceptance untouched); (2) B0-4 approved - add NP5-01/02/03 verified prerequisite wording (not the NP umbrella card; no early NP-pass claim) to p8-entry/p8-base/r10-p8 notes; (3) B0-1 option (c) - append the blocked-by-r07-p8 fact to r10-p8/p8-base notes (no waive, no fake unblock; wait for R07 closeout verified or explicit user waive) and do not delete r07-p8 from depends_on; (4) card-G observation 1 - the 7 W4 entity cards had depends_on=[] conflicting with the prerequisites-only-verified rule; fill real edges per the draft section 2 (E1<-NP5 proxy, E2<-r01-p8, E3<-r07-p8+NP proxy+r01-r05/r08/r09, E4<-E3, E5<-m10-p7, E6<-r07-p8+E1-E5+NP proxy, E7<-E6+E2+g28-p8+r06-flex-closeout) and mark registration-state pending checks; (5) B0-3 - dependency review with 0 errors 0 warnings appended as an addendum to the W4 governance doc (no rewrite). Governance only; no acceptance changes, no criteria changes; zero GPU/windows; no src/tests/fixtures/scripts writes.

acceptance: B0-2：`2026-10-11-roadmap-g10-p5` 的 depends_on 含 `2026-11-04-g10-p5-family-closeout`；acceptance 逐字未动；note 记录改指裁定。
B0-4：p8-entry / p8-base / r10-p8 三卡 note 含「NP5-01/02/03 verified」且含「不提前标 NP 通过」；不出现 NP 已通过/门禁通过表述。
B0-1：r10-p8 / p8-base 的 note 出现 blocked-by-r07-p8 事实句（含 r07-p8 当前 proposed、解除条件 R07 收口 verified 或用户明确 waive）；depends_on 中 r07-p8 未被删除；无 waive 决策记录。
观察 1：7 张实体卡 depends_on 按草案 §2 前置列补齐（E1←NP5-00 代理卡；E2←r01-p8；E3←r07-p8+NP 代理+r01–r05/r08/r09；E4←E3；E5←m10-p7；E6←r07-p8+E1–E5+NP 代理；E7←E6+E2+g28-p8+r06-flex-closeout）；note 标「登记态待补 checks，不标可开工」。
B0-3：`normify status` 复核 **错误 0 / 警告 0**（记录前后快照与冲突数变化），结果 append 进 `docs/development-evidence/plan/W4-dependency-governance.md`（不重写原文）。
边界：写域仅 `.normify/changes/**` + `docs/development-evidence/plan/**`；`unchanged src/`、`tests/`、`fixtures/`、`scripts/`；不改占位卡 acceptance/判据/参考/容差；零 GPU、零窗；不宣称 P8 准入通过。
四门禁 fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit + `normify check`；中文提交。
note: Chief 2026-11-11 12:3x 裁定 + Arch `w4-b0-rulings-addendum.md`（0f484505…/5,445 B，工作材料非证据）。B0-1 走 (c) 只登记事实、不 waive；B0-2/B0-4 批准执行；观察 1 按草案 §2 前置列补 7 张实体卡依赖；B0-3 复核 addendum 追加不重写。纯治理、零 GPU/零窗，13:40 硬停。
